出生地: 英国,苏格兰,北拉纳克郡,贝尔希尔
简介: Stuart performed in 'Macbeth' at Trafalgar Studios starring James McAvoy and directed by Jamie Lloyd (2013) before reappearing in 'Richard III' alongside Martin Freeman, again directed by Lloyd (2014). He starred as 'Marcus' in 'The Hunt' at The Almeida Theatre. He was nominated for 'Best Actor in a Play' At The Stage Debut Awards 2019 for his performance. Stuart is represented by Gordon and French.
